title: California Summer School (USA) | Levels Academy
description: California summer school options with English classes, campus accommodation and iconic excursions across LA & beyond.
blocks: Northridge Summer School, located on the campus of California State University, offers the perfect combination of learning, travel, and relaxation. The program includes a variety of options to suit all interests. We offer group trips with an accompanying guide, and, if preferred, you can also travel individually.
Campus: Modern and secure housing, library, classrooms, sports fields, swimming pools, gardens
Recreational Activities: Sports competitions, parties, talent shows, themed evenings
Excursions: Hollywood, San Francisco, Las Vegas, Grand Canyon
Networking: Interaction with students of different nationalities and leading lecturers
These are the standard activities that all participants of the summer school will have the opportunity to attend without any extra cost.
